Btd.notes: NOT a melee enemy that can be beaten by hp alone. Gohma is rooted in the lava and never moves (no speedF, no gravity, no acch) - it only rotates toward the player, so walk/run/hover/fly_speed are 0 and notice/lose/attack_range/gravity/terminal/height are null because the decomp has no such constants. The fight is two-phase and the hp field only applies to phase 2. Phase 1: the shell is invulnerable (eye hits just ping, d_a_btd.cpp:453). Link must grapple Valoo's tail (actor Kui, param 0x511, d_a_kui.cpp) which drops the ceiling rock (actor Dr2, d_a_dr2.cpp:302-312); the rock sets btd->m02F6 and Gohma sinks (SIZUMU1/2/3) while a crack brk plays. Three rock drops (m6190 counter) trigger WARERU1/WARERU2 and set m02E0 = 1. Phase 2: the eye becomes damageable, but only while the eyelid is open - it opens for 20 frames whenever Link swings a weapon or throws something within 400 units, and randomly every 100-250 frames. A hit knocks Gohma down (DAMAGE1 -> DAMAGE2 loop) for 150 frames; Link can land up to 5 Atp of extra hits during that window before Gohma recovers. 10 hp total. A remake needs: the grapple target + falling-rock actor, the 3-crack shell counter, an eyelid open/closed gate on the target sphere, and the 150-frame knockdown window - hp/damage alone will not reproduce the fight. Attacks: jab (RJAB1/2/3, 37f, hit window frames 18-22, Atp 1 - what the schema fields describe), arm slam (RATTACK1..5, hit at frame 39, Atp 2, then the arm is stuck in the lava for 150-250 frames - the classic opening), lunge punch (same clips with a 0xc00 tracking turn), and three fire breaths (forward FATTACK, upward UE_KAEN when Link is on the high ledge, sideways YOKO_KAEN), all Atp 2 via fire_sph_src. The 'ranged' entry describes the forward fire breath - it is not a projectile actor but a sphere that sweeps from the mouth to 1000 units over 10 frames, so speed 100 u/f is derived, not a literal. Lava splashes (50 sibuki spheres, Atp 1, r40) rain down after the slam and landing. radius 300 is the largest of the 19 body spheres (at_size), not a real body cylinder - Gohma has no single body collider, and its claw cylinders reach x +/-750, z 1680, so the actual footprint is far bigger. No /* Nonmatching */ regions: d_a_btd.cpp is fully decompiled. Placed in M_DragB (Dragon Roost Cavern boss room) and Xboss0 (Ganon's Tower boss rematch, which sets GOHMA_TRIALS_CLEAR instead of the stage boss-dead field). clips.walk / clips.run are null on purpose: no walk or run animation exists in Btd.arc.

Bkm.notes: NOT a melee enemy and the hp field is only half the fight. Kalle Demos is a bulb that hangs from the ceiling on 20 BMDHAND tentacles and drifts around; its own body has no attack sphere except the r100/h400 contact cylinder (Atp 1). Its attacks are delegated to the 8 BMDFOOT vines, and the schema's attack_frames/hit_frame/damage describe the BMDFOOT close whip (ASI_ATTACK2, 43 frames, spheres live throughout, strike at ~frame 27, Atp 1). The long-range option is the burrowing vine (ASI_UMARU -> underground tracking -> ASI_DATTACK1/2/3) - it is not a projectile, so 'ranged' is null. Phase structure: Link cuts the ceiling tentacles (each 2 hp, r90-110 target spheres, boomerang works on them but is masked out on the bulb). Every cut decrements m331, which both slows the bulb (speedF = 0.15*m331, so 3.0 -> 0) and lowers it (hover = 250 + 2.5*m331 on the USA build, 300 down to 250 above home). When the last one is cut the bulb falls with gravity -3.0, plays HANA_OTIRU, and stays open for exactly 100 frames with the core exposed; hits on the r50 core sphere drain the 15 hp with an 8-frame invulnerability each. Then it closes (HANA_TOJIRU), the tentacles re-attach, and the cycle repeats. Two extra mechanics a remake needs: (1) if Link is within 200 units when the bulb closes it eats him - HANA_EAT for 50 frames then HANA_HAKIDASU with setThrowDamage of 4; (2) using Forest Water on the exposed core within 300 units is an instant kill regardless of hp (d_a_bmd.cpp:601-607). Fields left null: notice/lose (no sight-distance test exists - the boss is always active in its room, and attention_info.distances[BATTLE]=4 is only a lock-on band), terminal (the fall has no clamp), knockback (core hits apply no push, only the 8-frame invuln). attack_range 1300 is not a notice range - it is the threshold that picks the close whip over the burrowing vine. radius 300 is the Tg body sphere and height 400 the contact cylinder; the runtime cylinder height is raised to 3000 during play (line 1648), which is a keep-out column rather than a body size. clips.damage is the body's fall-and-open clip; the actual flinch is coa_damage (14 frames) on the separate head/core model, which is where flinch_frames comes from. Placed in kinBOSS (Forbidden Woods boss room) and Xboss1 (Ganon's Tower rematch, which sets KALLE_DEMOS_TRIALS_CLEAR instead of the stage boss-dead field).
